pairs.subject: optional-dependency-degradation
pairs.evidence: app/api/intake/[id]/voice-connect/route.ts:89 An unconfigured voice relay gets a closed-union refusal code that is distinct from the INTAKE_VOICE_CONNECT_FAILED store fault, and keyless LLM turns degrade with their cause on the wire. Every dependency-backed intake surface therefore either works or refuses honestly.

techniques.evidence: app/api/intake/[id]/voice-connect/route.ts:89 The configuration check runs before the mint, and the permanent gap (503 NOT_CONFIGURED) is told apart from the transient failure (safeJsonError CONNECT_FAILED). The env names in `need` fall under the standard's carve-out for operator-only self-hosted audiences, since the route sits behind requireOperator. The code is pinned by intake-refusal-guard.test.ts.

app/api/intake/[id]/message/route.ts:234 The degraded answer carries its cause, so a keyless install and a provider outage stop reading the same. intake-degradation-contract.test.ts pins this for both turn routes.

app/api/intake/[id]/voice-complete/route.ts:96 Keyless extraction declines honestly (extracted:false), keeping the transcript and leaving the brief untouched. The malformed-config half is not read by this context and was judged in llm-config-provider.

app/api/intake/[id]/message/route.ts:77 The late-bound intake_round runner is a classifier/writer whose purpose is known, not a validator that can object. The route asks for best-effort explicitly, scoped to this call, and logs.
app/api/intake/route.ts:14 The keyless deterministic path is a permanent product posture, not a stand-in for a platform gap expected to close, so no retirement condition is owed.
